title: 第25章 虚空玄金第26章 虚空刃
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
天兽森林离圆月城并不远。
大半天之后，前方的地平线之上，就出现了一道巍峨磅礴的巨大山脉，横亘在大地之上。
“天兽森林，终于到了。”
叶云飞望着前方的莽莽群山，目光中，有精芒闪现。
天兽森林之中，栖居着许多妖兽和魔兽。
据说，在天兽森林的最深处，还盘踞着几头恐怖的兽王。
所以，绝大部分的武者，都只敢在外围的区域活动。
而不敢随便进入天兽森林的最深处。
“哦？
天兽小镇？”
叶云飞策马而行，发现在天兽山脉的山脚处，有一个小镇，是进入天兽森林的必经之路。
小镇之中，人来人往，热闹非凡。
叶云飞放开马匹，走进小镇，行走在狭窄的街道上。
再往前面去，就是莽莽丛林，已经不适合骑马了。
街道两旁，一字排开数不清的地摊，出售或收购各种与武者相关的物资。
“生灵草，专门补充灵力的灵药，十块灵晶石一株！”
“三生大力丸，一百块灵晶石，物美价廉，是天兽森林历炼和探险，必备良药！”
……
叫卖之声，讨价还价之声，不绝于耳。
不过，叶云飞知道，这样的地方，鱼龙混杂，想买到真正的好东西，很难。

“地品灵器，一万块灵晶石。”
突然，一道叫卖声，引起了叶云飞的注意。
只见，一个地摊上，一个壮实的青年，双膝跪在地上。
他前面铺着一大块已看不清颜色的布，布面之上，摆着一柄黑黝黝的匕首。
“哈哈，笑死我了，这样一把破匕首，竟然敢说是地品灵器。”
“真正的地品灵器，价值最少十几万块灵晶石，光听价格，就知道是假的。”
“这小子，良心太坏了，拿这样一柄破匕首，专门来糊弄水鱼的吧！”
……
地摊之前，虽然围了不少人，但是，没有一个人相信，全都冷嘲热讽，抱着看热闹的心态。
“你们不要乱说！
我没有骗人。
我是这附近的猎户，这柄匕首是我祖上传下之物，代代珍藏。
如果不是我父亲病情严重，我也不舍得拿出来卖的。”
那壮实青年着急地解释道。
“你们看，我父亲也在这里。”
那壮实青年，指着一个躺在他身旁，脸色苍白，似乎正处于晕迷状态的老者。
content_en:
The Heavenly Beast Forest is not far from Yuanyue City.
Most of a day later, a majestic and majestic mountain range appeared on the horizon ahead, stretching across the land.
"The Forest of Heavenly Beasts has finally arrived."
Ye Yunfei looked at the vast mountains ahead, with a bright light shining in his eyes.
In the Forest of Heavenly Beasts, there are many monsters and magical beasts living there.
It is said that in the deepest part of the Heavenly Beast Forest, there are still several terrifying beast kings.
Therefore, the vast majority of warriors only dare to operate in the peripheral areas.
And dare not enter the deepest part of the Heavenly Beast Forest casually.
"Oh?
Sky Beast Town? "
Ye Yunfei rode his horse and discovered that there was a small town at the foot of the Tianshou Mountains, which was the only way to enter the Tianshou Forest.
In the small town, people were coming and going, and it was very lively.
Ye Yunfei let go of the horse, walked into the town, and walked on the narrow streets.
Further ahead, there is a vast jungle, which is no longer suitable for riding horses.
On both sides of the street, countless stalls were lined up, selling or purchasing various warrior-related materials.
"Spiritual Grass, an elixir specially used to replenish spiritual power, one plant worth ten spiritual crystals!"
"Sansheng Dali Pill, one hundred spiritual crystals, high quality and low price. It is a must-have medicine for training and adventure in the beast forest!"
…
The sounds of hawking and bargaining are endless.
However, Ye Yunfei knew that it was difficult to buy really good things in a place like this, where there was a mixture of good and bad.
"Earth-grade spiritual weapon, ten thousand pieces of spiritual crystals."
Suddenly, a shouting sound caught Ye Yunfei's attention.
I saw a sturdy young man kneeling on the ground on a stall.
In front of him was a large piece of cloth whose color could no longer be seen, and on the cloth lay a dark dagger.
"Haha, I'm laughing so hard that such a broken dagger dares to be said to be an earth-grade spiritual weapon."
"A genuine earth-grade spiritual weapon is worth at least hundreds of thousands of spiritual crystals. Just by hearing the price, you can tell it is fake."
"This boy has such a bad conscience. He must have used such a broken dagger just to fool the fish in the water!"
…
Although there were many people gathered around the street stall, no one believed it. They were all sarcastic and just watching the excitement.
"Don't talk nonsense!
I'm not lying.
I am a hunter from around here, and this dagger is passed down from my ancestors and has been treasured from generation to generation.
If my father wasn't seriously ill, I wouldn't be willing to sell it. "
The sturdy young man explained anxiously.
"Look, my father is here too."
The sturdy young man pointed at an old man lying next to him, his face pale, and he seemed to be in a coma.
